row.evidence: Agiloft's help centre says Agiloft CLM integrates with "any identity provider (IdP) that supports ... (SCIM) 2.0" to create, update, deactivate and reactivate users, while its pricing page publishes no tiers, only a Get Pricing form.
row.notes: New row. Agiloft sells one quote-based CLM platform (pricing page is a 'Get Pricing' form; licences are Admin, Standard and Requester), so SCIM, like everything else, is Contact Sales; gated follows the rule for quote-only vendors (same as Juro). The docs do not name an edition for SCIM. SCIM 2.0 at https://{kb}.agiloft.com/scim/v2 with bearer tokens from a SCIM profile (Setup > Access > Configure SCIM); requires User Status Management to deploy deactivation. Users only: groups/teams and custom attributes are not synced (default groups/teams per profile instead); a SCIM delete request deactivates rather than deletes. Okta and Entra are documented as custom SCIM apps; Okta's OIN 'Agiloft' app is SWA only (2015) and the Entra gallery app is SAML with JIT. SAML/OAuth SSO and LDAP sync are also available. REST/OpenAPI (Platform edition) exposes the People table, e.g. PUT /contacts/{id}.

plans.name: Agiloft CLM (Platform edition)
plans.notes: No public tier table; the pricing page is a quote form. SCIM's edition is not stated in the docs.

auth.token_source: Setup > Access > Configure SCIM > SCIM profile > Bearer Tokens tab > Generate Token
auth.notes: Multiple active tokens per profile; tokens can be revoked or deleted. Expiry not documented.

operations.notes: Update is supported but the HTTP method (PUT vs PATCH) is not documented. A SCIM delete request deactivates the user rather than deleting the record.

deprovision.data_retained: User record kept with User Is Active = false; the account's activities stay in audit logs and other records.

custom.how: Custom attributes are not synchronized through SCIM; only direct attribute values (no expressions) can be mapped.

attributes.notes: The User Attributes tab lists 'the standard SCIM user attributes' mapped to Agiloft fields; the full list is not published. Presence of the enterprise extension decides whether users go to Employees or External Users.

roles.how: No role or group mapping from the IdP; each SCIM profile assigns default groups, a default primary team and default teams to new users.

limitations.text: Group and team synchronization is not supported (planned for a later release).
One-way sync; changes in Agiloft are overwritten by the IdP for mapped fields.
Expression-based attribute values are not supported.

scim.notes: sso_required=false: the docs say SCIM and SSO can be used independently and SCIM can be set up before SSO.

user_api.plan: Platform edition (older editions: Advanced or Premium)
user_api.notes: OpenAPI/REST is generated per KB (Swagger UI at Setup > System > View REST documentation); users are records in the People (contacts) table. SOAP is legacy and off by default.

endpoints.purpose: Get an access token (expires after 15 minutes by default)
Update a record in the People table

rate_limits.text: No rate limits per user, token, KB, or otherwise.

okta.notes: OIN 'Agiloft' app (last updated Sep. 4 2015) marks only SWA (page markup). Agiloft documents SCIM by enabling SCIM on a SAML app in Okta with the KB base URL, i.e. a custom app.

entra.notes: Gallery app 'Agiloft Contract Management Suite' is SAML SSO with JIT; Agiloft documents SCIM via a custom enterprise app's Provisioning tab with the KB SCIM base URL.
